children: Costco Wholesale Corp. (COST, Financials) is getting close to a major sales milestone. The warehouse retailer reported fiscal 2026 net sales of $297.3 billion, up 10.2% from $269.9 billion a year earlier.
August also remained strong. Costco reported monthly net sales of $23.70 billion, up 9.9% year over year.
Comparable sales excluding gasoline prices and foreign exchange rose 5.6% during the four weeks ended Aug. 30. For the full fiscal year, comparable sales on the same basis increased 6.6%.
The company said the later timing of Labor Day negatively affected August total and comparable sales by just under 75 basis points.
Bank of America remains bullish on the stock. Analyst Christopher Nardone reiterated a Buy rating and kept a $1,200 price target, implying roughly 29% upside from recent levels.
Nardone argued that Costco continues to gain share by offering strong value while also attracting more higher-income shoppers.
For investors, the key point is scale. Costco is still producing double-digit annual sales growth even as revenue approaches $300 billion.
The next question is whether comparable sales can reaccelerate after slowing from stronger growth rates earlier in the year.

title: Costco Is Closing In on $300 Billion. Wall Street Still Sees More Upside
